CLASSICS WE FEEL DEEPLY 
FOR 
@BARSOMMA 
"So much about the world of cocktails 
excites us—how brine makes it way into a 
Martini, or how the old-timey Last Word 
finds new romance across the globe... We 
hope that through these reimagined, 
forgotten classics you'll find connection 
and a new sense of intrigue. Enjoy!" 
— Mel
